boards.title: Drafts
boards.spec_label: Unposted works: the work row minus what AO3 cannot know yet; header '4 drafts - 2 expiring this week'; a 'N days left' chip and 'Created ...' per draft; Post and Delete are the swipe, editing is the tap, deleting asks first.

items.what: 'N days left' chip, 'Created ...' and 'N expiring this week'
items.note:
The code's reason for not building these - 'the drafts listing carries no creation date' - is contradicted by otwarchive: every unposted work's blurb (drafts is works/_work_blurb over unposted_works) carries

This draft will be scheduled for deletion on DATE

, DATE = created_at + 29 days, formatted date_short_html (Mon 05 Oct 2026). Days left and 'expiring this week' come from the page already fetched; 'Created' is that date minus 29 days. otwarchive-facts-wave3 Q17.
items.fix: Parse the notice's span.date / abbr.month / span.year per blurb into AO3WorkSummary (an optional draftDeletionDate); chip = whole days until it in the device calendar; tally counts <= 7 days. A missing notice leaves the chip off, as today.
items.test: Parser fixture built from otwarchive's _work_module markup (not invented) yields the date; a pure daysLeft(until:now:) boundary test (today -> 0, tomorrow -> 1).

items.note: Both are AO3 writes and already live in the editor behind their own buttons; a swipe was judged too easy to fire (posting notifies subscribers and cannot be undone). Owner may overrule.
